IMPORTANT: Missing gradle-wrapper.jar

The gradle-wrapper.jar file is needed to build the APK but cannot be included in this text-based project.

TO GENERATE THE GRADLE WRAPPER:

1. Install Android Studio and open the AndroidApp project
2. Android Studio will automatically generate the missing gradle-wrapper.jar
3. Or run this command in the AndroidApp directory:
   
   gradle wrapper --gradle-version=8.0

4. This will create the gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar file

ALTERNATIVE:
- Download gradle-wrapper.jar from an existing Android project
- Copy it to: AndroidApp/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Once the gradle-wrapper.jar is present, you can build the APK using:
- Android Studio: Build > Build APK(s)
- Command line: ./gradlew assembleDebug
- Or use the provided build scripts: build_apk.sh or build_apk.bat
